summary: Controls output detail, generation latency, and image-token cost. Auto lets GPT Image 2 balance them; low is fastest and least expensive, medium is balanced, and high uses the most image tokens for maximum detail.
combines: The single largest cost lever on OpenAI images: quality drives output token count, and image output bills at 32 to 40 per 1M tokens.

usage.code: quality is read from state.imageGenerationConfig with an 'auto' fallback and sent through Responses image tools, images.generate, and images.edit
usage.what: Controls output quality, latency, and image-token usage on every OpenAI image-generation path.
